inputs: held-out sequences of the model's own distribution
estimator: token-local J^T J power iteration on the block (jvp + vjp), same map as survey_sigma1_v2, block input at position t
perturbation: h_{l,t} += sign * eps * ||h_{l,t}|| * u, u in {v_1, 4 random unit vectors}, signs averaged; pre-hook on the block input

readouts.kl_t: KL(clean || perturbed) of the output distribution at t
readouts.kl_seq: mean KL over positions t..T-2 (causal) or all positions (bidirectional)
readouts.dce: change of the model's own loss over positions t..T-2 (next-token CE; real-text CE for randlab) or over the masked positions (bidirectional)

prov_gpu: NVIDIA RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell Server Edition
